<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">VIRAL GENETICS, INC.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">CERTIFICATE OF AMENDMENT TO</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">THE CERTIFICATE OF DESIGNATION</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">OF SERIES A PREFERRED STOCK</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">(Pursuant to Section 151 of the Delaware
General Corporation Law)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">AUGUST 16, 2012</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">Viral Genetics, Inc., a Delaware
corporation (the &quot;Corporation&quot;), hereby certifies that, pursuant to authority vested in the Board of Directors of
the Corporation (the &quot;Board of Directors&quot;) by Article Four of the Corporation's Certificate of Incorporation (the
&quot;Certificate of Incorporation&rdquo;) and pursuant to the provisions of Section 151 of the Delaware General Corporation
Law, the following resolution was duly adopted by the Board of Directors on August 16, 2012;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 44pt; text-indent: 22pt">RESOLVED, that Paragraph 7 &quot;No Reissuance of Series
A Preferred Stock&rdquo; of the Certificate of Designation of Series A Preferred stock dated April 28, 2009, be and
it hereby is, deleted in its entirety.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 44pt; text-indent: 22pt">RESOLVED, that the Series A
Preferred Shares shall consist of up to 10,000,000 shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned have
hereunto set his hand as of the 16th day of August 2012.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
